entry.summary: The pet character sheet can show the wrong critical-strike value for Ferocity. Blizzard says the actual gameplay effect is unaffected.

entry.summary: Blizzard lists some creature, mount and other textures as unfinished. Visual updates remain pending.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Known Issues - October 8

entry.summary: Some profession icons are broken in the beta. This is a reported display issue, not a confirmed fix.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Known Issues - October 8

entry.summary: A correction is planned for Auto Shot and wand wind-up. Timing and delivery remain unconfirmed.
Mangle is renamed; its signature debuff is removed.
Critical healing now works.
Base damage rises by roughly half.
The pet attack-power bonus is reduced.
Bat pets can use the ability.
The proc lasts longer.
Damage multipliers no longer apply twice. Gameplay impact needs review.
More time to use the buff between fights.
Shorter cooldown; listed under Holy.
Rank 1 stays at 25%; ranks 2–8 increase. These are weapon-damage coefficients, not total DPS. The issue list still promises a fix.
The wording and numeric direction disagree. Await clarification.
The Holy Strike damage bonus increases.
The update limits activation to non-periodic critical hits. The issue list still promises a fix; this is separate from the stack-limit change.
The maximum stack count falls.
Critical healing now works.
The update reports Twilight Focus pushback protection working for Starshards. The issue list still promises a fix; delivery build is unknown.
Sapping a PvP-flagged target flags the Rogue.
Ranks three and four gain damage; exact values are unstated.
Critical healing now works.
Shield scaling uses ten percent of spell healing.
Higher top-rank proc chance; eligible attacks also changed.
Longer base cooldown; a separate talent can reduce it.
Swipe gains 3% of attack power; its tooltip correction is still pending.
The fifth rank grants less parry.
Combustion has one fewer charge.
Holy Shield provides a larger block chance bonus.
Devouring Plague can critically strike.
A missed Expose Armor no longer removes all combo points.
Totemic Recall restores mana again.
Hellfire can critically strike.
Bloodthirst gains a larger attack-power contribution.
Blizzard opened the City of Dalaran dungeon for beta testing on October 8. This announcement does not provide a verified boss roster or complete loot tables.

entry.summary: The Desolace chain beginning with Valley of Bones now starts at level 35 instead of 30.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Matching level-35 equip requirements for rewards from that chain were announced for a future hotfix. The October 8 post does not confirm that this reward change has shipped.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Blizzard reports a higher threat bonus for both bear forms. This supports tank threat; it is not a claim about total damage.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Thorns gains less damage from spell power, and its base damage returns to Vanilla values. This is a reduction in the stated scaling.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Dungeon kills award approximately 20% more XP. Low-level enemy penalties again use each player's level; the restriction for extremely different party levels remains.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Expose Prey remains active longer after it is applied, extending its useful window.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Blizzard reports completing the 16-point Legacy grant for beta testers. This is later fulfillment evidence, rather than the earlier promise; individual player receipt was not independently checked.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.ability: Early Frostbolt, Fireball and Arcane Missiles
entry.summary: Blizzard adjusted early spell ranks for smoother damage progression. The post does not supply a complete before-and-after damage table.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Retribution Aura receives less damage from spell power. Its base damage is also reduced separately; the coefficient alone does not describe total damage.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Channel calculations and rank-specific healing and mana costs were adjusted. Effects differ across ranks, so this is a mixed change rather than an overall buff or nerf.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Fire Nova should no longer immediately consume an Elemental Focus effect that it has just triggered.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: The existing demon is stunned while a replacement summon is being cast.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Demoralizing Shout again generates threat against affected enemies. This change does not resolve the separate older Rage wording conflict.
entry.postTitle: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes – Updated October 8

entry.summary: Darnassus and Thunder Bluff gain barbershops. Staff are present at the shops, and city guards can give directions.

entry.ability: Safer campfires and clearer camp buffs
entry.summary: Campfires no longer damage characters below level five and deal less damage when a character is below ninety percent health. Camp feature wording now clarifies which buffs cannot be combined.
entry.valueText: No campfire damage below level 5; reduced damage below 90% health

entry.ability: Cooldown tracking adds Rogue and racials
entry.summary: The Cooldown Manager now covers Rogue and racial abilities. Previously supported classes should no longer show duplicate entries for different ranks of the same spell.
Forms prevent new Disarm effects. Shifting after a Disarm does not remove the existing effect, and its damage penalty continues.
Shifting Power trades mana for Cat energy, with a follow-on talent shortening its cooldown. Effects that discount shapeshifting also discount its mana cost.
entry.valueText: 55% base mana → 40 Energy; 16s cooldown; talent reduction 4/8s

entry.ability: Wetlands excavation and expanded dungeon access
entry.summary: The beta adds Excavation Site: Wetlands and opens Razorfen Downs and Uldaman. These are the announced beta access ranges, not confirmed replacement recommendations for every Classic guide.

entry.ability: Dungeon quest bonus XP is reduced
entry.summary: The extra XP awarded above a normal quest’s value is cut in half. This does not say total dungeon quest XP is halved. Some rewards were also adjusted without a complete per-quest list.
entry.valueText: Extra XP above normal quest values: −50%

entry.summary: The pet stable and compact party/raid controls receive gamepad support. Gamepad UI bindings remain fixed; rebinding affects the keyboard and mouse interface. Moving macros from a gamepad bar is also reported fixed.

entry.ability: Wand values and gathering behavior change
entry.summary: Crafted common and uncommon wands now sell to vendors for one copper. Starter zones have fewer Poor Copper Veins, and each creature can again be skinned only once.
entry.valueText: Common/uncommon crafted wands: vendor value 1 copper

entry.ability: Honor prices and currency cap increase
entry.summary: Most PvP gear and upgrade tokens cost roughly half again as much Honor. The higher currency cap makes room for these prices; check individual item costs rather than assuming every price changed equally.
The shot reaches 45 yards and temporarily extends the range of your next three shots. Plan the follow-up shots inside the ten-second window.
entry.valueText: 45-yard range; next 3 shots gain 10 yards within 10s

entry.summary: Characters can progress to level 30 in this update. Campfire’s higher-level reference guides are planning material; this announcement does not make all of that content beta-playable.
Moving can no longer be combined with Evocation. Choose a safe position before channeling.
The Fire proc has a new name. Look for Heating Up when reviewing your talents and buffs. This is a rename, not a separate second proc.
Less Intellect is converted into spell damage. The removed healing claim was a tooltip error; this talent did not grant healing.
Every rank grants less block chance. Holy Shield receives a separate increase in this update.

entry.ability: Close-range attacks can be parried from behind
entry.summary: Enemies may block or parry attacks from behind when the attacker is very close. The reported workaround is to leave more space. This remains an issue report, not a verified fix.

entry.ability: More dungeon recipe drops are available
entry.summary: The update enables a group of intended random dungeon drops for Blacksmithing and Leatherworking. It does not identify every recipe, location or drop probability, so individual unconfirmed origins remain marked in the crafting guides.
Many creatures and objects respawn faster in Hillsbrad Foothills, Ashenvale, Wetlands, Duskwood and Thousand Needles. This is a zone-wide selected summary; individual timers are not supplied.

entry.ability: Debuff threat and Retribution Aura remain under review
entry.summary: Some debuffs, including Faerie Fire and Demoralizing Shout, fail to generate threat. Retribution Aura incorrectly uses the target’s spell power. The issue list also conflicts with the update’s Dual Wield Specialization correction; no delivery build is confirmed.

New talents support Rage retention, off-hand accuracy and healing after selected Rage abilities. Whirlwind uses both weapons without a talent point. Flurry now requires Death Wish instead of Enrage; review your build rather than assuming the old route still applies.
entry.valueText: Lingering Rage: +2/4/6/8/10s before decay; Furious Precision: +4/7/10% off-hand hit

entry.summary: Two lines in the same update give different values for extra Rage from basic-attack critical hits. Campfire is keeping the conflict visible instead of choosing an unsupported result.

A talent reset costs one silver after sufficient time since the last reset. Repeated resets initially cost more, returning to one silver after an hour. This is a beta testing rule, not a permanent live-game price.
entry.valueText: Discounted reset: 1 silver · discount returns after 1 hour
